entries.trigger: A grace starts: owned non-hostile AI observes (native LOS plus fresh ray) a player with a raised weapon at 40 m < distance <= 80 m, once per actor-group/player pair per 45 s.
entries.steps: 1. Near an owned live neutral AI (for example the Chernogorsk police loop), stay in view at about 50 m. 2. Raise a weapon: the AI faces you and shouts (status text), keeps its own weapon up and does not fire. 3. Lower the weapon within 3 s (AILimits.CautionGraceSeconds): no shots, stance de-escalates. 4. Repeat after 45 s and keep the weapon raised past 3 s: the AI turns hostile about 3 s after the raise, as before. Require [HC Use] caution_warn count>=1 and one first-warn line with grace_s=3 and fire=none.
entries.prerequisites: EnableEncounters; provider ownership/faction and emote observation readiness; one server plus at most one client.
